generic_patterns.label: em dash
generic_patterns.advice: Replace with a full stop, comma, colon or parentheses.

generic_patterns.label: negative contrast setups (not just X but Y / It is not X. It is Y)
generic_patterns.advice: State the positive claim directly and drop the setup clause.

generic_patterns.label: formal connectives (Furthermore/Moreover/Additionally)
generic_patterns.advice: Use 'also', 'but', 'so', or start a new sentence.

generic_patterns.label: summary connectives (In summary/Overall/Ultimately)
generic_patterns.advice: Cut. If the paragraph is a summary the reader can tell.

generic_patterns.label: LLM corporate verbs (delve/leverage/foster/navigate/streamline)
generic_patterns.advice: Replace corporate/academic AI verbs with plain English: use, help, dig into, show, guide.

generic_patterns.label: puffery & overused adjectives (robust/pivotal/testament/multifaceted)
generic_patterns.advice: Exaggerated AI praise words. Cut or replace with concrete facts, metrics, or simpler words.

generic_patterns.label: abstract nouns (landscape/realm/tapestry/journey)
generic_patterns.advice: Name the actual thing instead of relying on cliché metaphors.

generic_patterns.label: canned opening (In today's fast-paced world)
generic_patterns.advice: Cliché opening with zero information. Cut straight to the actual point.

generic_patterns.label: hedge preamble (It is important to note)
generic_patterns.regex: [Ii]t('s| is| should be) ((important|worth|crucial|vital|essential) (to note|noting|mentioning|remembering|keeping in mind)|(worth noting|worth mentioning|noted that|mentioned that))
generic_patterns.advice: Delete the preamble and state the claim directly.

generic_patterns.label: rule of three in a sentence (A, B and C)
generic_patterns.advice: Check each one: is it a real list, or three items invented for rhythm?

Claude.label: sincerity tells (genuine/honest)
Claude.advice: Claude sincerity cluster (~10x human frequency). Cut or replace with 'real'.

Claude.label: rhetorical questions
Claude.advice: Claude asks ~3.9 per 1,000 words. In a report, convert to statements.

ChatGPT.label: because-chaining
ChatGPT.advice: ChatGPT hooks clauses with 'because' at ~6.5 per 1,000 words.

Gemini.label: intensifiers (incredibly/highly/massive/vital)
Gemini.advice: Gemini leads on booster words at ~6.1 per 1,000.

Gemini.label: uncontracted formality (it is / we must / do not)

DeepSeek.label: formulaic transitions (First and foremost / Last but not least)
DeepSeek.regex: \b(First and foremost|Last but not least|It is evident that)\b
DeepSeek.advice: DeepSeek/LLM formulaic transitional phrases. Replace with direct statements.

DeepSeek.label: sweeping false range (from X to Y, from A to B)
DeepSeek.advice: Double pseudo-range setup. Specific examples are much clearer.
